name: quickstart-guide
description: Use when a user pastes a Snowflake Quickstart URL or asks to learn/walk through a Quickstart. Fetches the source content from GitHub, parses it into stages, checks the learner's environment, and delivers a guided build experience with two modes (learner or builder). Triggers: quickstarts.snowflake.com, snowflake.com/en/developers/guides/, walk me through this quickstart, teach me this quickstart, learn this guide, I want to do this quickstart. Do NOT use for general SQL help or non-Quickstart tutorials.
